| S08 | 179.0–191.5 | 饥荒来了 / The hungry years | follow brother | The land turns dusty. Far away in Canaan the food runs out, and Jacob sends the brothers to Egypt to buy grain. |
| S09 | 191.5–210.0 | 梦成真了 / The dream comes true | fixed sacks | The brother kneels and bows low before the governor of Egypt. He has no idea who it is. Over Joseph's head the old dream flickers: the sheaves bowing. |
| S10 | 210.0–237.2 | 我就是约瑟 / I am Joseph | fixed joseph | Joseph cannot hold it in. He pulls off the head-cloth: it is him. The brother falls back, terrified, and says sorry. Joseph lifts him up and hugs him. |
| S11 | 237.2–251.4 | 一家团圆 / Together again | follow jacob | Old Jacob comes all the way to Egypt on his stick. Joseph runs to him. A long hug. |
| S12 | 251.4–270.2 | 坏事变好事 / God turns it to good | fixed all | The family faces the child: Jacob, Joseph and his brother wave. Pharaoh waves from his throne. |
